items.title: Microsoft Open-Sources Agensh: A Multi-Agent Harness for 1,024 Agents
items.summary: Microsoft Research open-sourced Agensh, a multi-agent harness with no central orchestrator. Self-organizing workers share a Git repo, chat and a findings board, scaling from 1 to 1,024 agents on ProgramBench under a 6-hour budget. The post Microsoft Open-Sources Agensh: A Multi-Agent Harness for 1,024 Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Cognition Open-Sources an Agent Plugin that Helps Secure Systems against Recent Cybersecurity Threats
items.summary: Cognition released the Devin Vulnerability Fixes plugin, 3 MIT-licensed agent skills that inventory, patch and test PHP, Node.js and self-managed GitLab deployments hit by this week’s critical RCE flaws, then open 1 PR per repo. The post Cognition Open-Sources an Agent Plugin that Helps Secure Systems against Recent Cybersecurity Threats appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meet Anthropic’s sandbox-runtime: OS-Level Sandboxing for AI Agents, No Containers
items.summary: Anthropic sandbox-runtime (srt) is the open-source, OS-level sandbox behind Claude Code. It restricts file and network access for agents, MCP servers and CLI tools with Seatbelt on macOS and bubblewrap on Linux, no containers needed. The post Meet Anthropic’s sandbox-runtime: OS-Level Sandboxing for AI Agents, No Containers appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Stateful Agentic Engineering Copilots with Letta: Core Memory, Shared State, Semantic Retrieval, Custom Tools, Streaming, and Portable Agent Workflows
items.summary: Discover how to extend agentic memory beyond basic prompts by building a stateful engineering copilot with Letta. This comprehensive guide covers inspectable core memory, archival vector retrieval, multi-agent shared state, custom tools, and portable workflows. items.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open Small Language Model for Local Voice Agents, Game Characters and Robots
items.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open small language model post-trained from Gemma 4 E4B for local voice assistants, game characters and robots, targeting about 4GB of VRAM on RTX and Jetson. The post NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open Small Language Model for Local Voice Agents, Game Characters and Robots appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Kyutai CADRE: Video Autoencoders That Cut World Model Lag Below 230 ms
items.summary: Kyutai released CADRE, a family of 7 open causal diffusion video autoencoders for interactive world models. World models built on CADRE run at 20 fps on 1 H100 and react in under 230 ms. The post Kyutai CADRE: Video Autoencoders That Cut World Model Lag Below 230 ms appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro: A 2.8T Total/104B Active Params (MoE) Model with 1M Context
items.summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 2.8T-parameter, 104B-active MoE model with 1M-token context. It scores 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, costs $2/$10 per million tokens, and open weights arrive by Nov 4, 2026. The post Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro: A 2.8T Total/104B Active Params (MoE) Model with 1M Context appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
items.summary: TinyFish published two engineering research articles on agentic search. One defines a 7-phase production architecture with evidence contracts and bounded retries. The other explains why its deep research system dropped a separate planner and per-query subagents. The post TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Google Cloud Launches Agent Compute Engine: A MicroVM per AI Agent
items.summary: Google Cloud announced Agent Compute Engine, a compute service that gives every AI agent its own hardware-isolated microVM with no credentials inside. It already runs Gemini agents and enters preview in the coming months. The post Google Cloud Launches Agent Compute Engine: A MicroVM per AI Agent appeared first on MarkTechPost.
